SELECT COUNT(*) AS flight_count
FROM flights f
JOIN airports a1 ON f.SourceAirport = a1.AirportCode
JOIN airports a2 ON f.DestAirport = a2.AirportCode
WHERE a1.City = 'Aberdeen'
  AND a2.City = 'Ashley';
